deadEnd.details: Observed 2026-07-13 via the autonomy benchmark. The store forces Shop Pay accelerated checkout: the /cart/<variant>:1 permalink 302s straight to shop.app/checkout (leaving the session cart empty), and the Add-to-cart button path is diverted too. Shop Pay needs a Shop account + SMS OTP, so there is no unattended guest-card path. The Shopify PLATFORM recipe stays partial — other stores expose a normal guest checkout.

notes: Product handles rotate — refresh via /products.json if revisiting.
